Holder briefing [https://phoenix-foundation-irregularities.pfc.zone/]

Payment source records

A curated guide to the underlying funding and governance records.

This briefing examines funding decisions and governance procedures, not personal character. It does not allege dishonesty or infer intent from a payment, vote or sequence of events. Discussion and corrections should address specific records; personal attacks, unwanted contact and harassment have no place here.

The original site’s commentary is not reproduced here. These guides retain relevant source downloads; the shorter briefing explains their scope, caveats and alternative explanations.

Funding and accounting method [https://phoenix-foundation-irregularities.pfc.zone/funding/] · Approvals, delivery and technical control [https://phoenix-foundation-irregularities.pfc.zone/governance/] · Dated chronology [https://phoenix-foundation-irregularities.pfc.zone/timeline/]

Read the records in context

Project receipts are not a measure of personal profit. A beneficiary’s participation does not alone establish wrongdoing. Timing and voting agreement do not establish motive. Dated captures do not describe every later development.
